Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing extended military leave for certain public employees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to military leaves of absence for certain publicsector military reservists and national guard members; and adding a newsection to chapter 38.40 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 38.40 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Every officer and employee of the state who is a member of theWashington national guard or of the army, navy, air force, coast guard,or marine corps reserve of the United States, or of any organizedreserve or armed forces of the United States is entitled to and shallbe granted military leave of absence from their employment for a periodnot exceeding two years subject to a mobilization for a periodexceeding thirty days under Title 10 or 32 of the United States Code.This leave shall be granted in order that the person may report foractive duty. This military leave of absence is in addition to anyvacation or sick leave to which the officer or employee might otherwisebe entitled, and shall not involve any loss of efficiency rating,privileges, or pay. During the period of military leave, the officer p. 1 SSB 6578or employee shall receive his or her normal pay from the state afterdeduction of military pay and allowances. The department of personnelshall adopt rules necessary to implement this section.
